content.introduction: The sources provide insights into BlackRock's 2026 Fall Investment Directions, highlighting themes such as AI-driven volatility, the impact of political events like midterms, and a steepening yield curve. They emphasize the importance of building diversified portfolios as competition for capital intensifies. The report also mentions the resilience of equities supported by AI-led earnings growth amidst higher global government bond yields. Specific data points include the "moderate" risk cohort models with an overall equity allocation between 50-65%, and polling indicating a rebound in advisor sentiment since March lows. The sources do not provide a definitive answer to specific questions not directly addressed.

# Fall 2026 Investment Directions

## AI, Politics, & Portfolios

Explore our 2026 Fall Investment Directions for advisors covering AI-driven volatility, midterms, a steepening yield curve, and how investors can build diversified portfolios as competition for capital intensifies.

[...] BlackRock polling also reveals that advisor sentiment has rebounded. Since the March lows, sentiment has steadily recovered, with the percentage of respondents expressing bullish sentiment nearly doubling, while the percentage of those expressing a bearish view halved.56

# Scarcity vs. abundance

September 15, 2026 | Global government bond yields have broken higher as sovereign borrowing competes with private financing needs led by AI. Yet equities are resilient, supported by solid AI-led earnings growth. We stay constructive on risk but are increasingly selective, favoring AI bottlenecks, shorter-term bonds and opportunities beyond asset class labels.
